sql:
SELECT pc.ProductCategoryName,
       avgIf(day_total, IsWorkDay = 'WeekEnd') AS avg_weekend_day,
       avgIf(day_total, IsWorkDay = 'WorkDay') AS avg_weekday,
       avgIf(day_total, IsWorkDay = 'WeekEnd') - avgIf(day_total, IsWorkDay = 'WorkDay') AS abs_difference,
       (avgIf(day_total, IsWorkDay = 'WeekEnd') - avgIf(day_total, IsWorkDay = 'WorkDay'))
         * 100.0 / nullif(avgIf(day_total, IsWorkDay = 'WorkDay'), 0) AS pct_bigger
FROM (
    SELECT f.DateKey AS DateKey,
           pc.ProductCategoryKey AS ProductCategoryKey,
           pc.ProductCategoryName AS ProductCategoryName,
           d.IsWorkDay AS IsWorkDay,
           sum(f.SalesAmount) AS day_total
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
    JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
    JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
    JOIN retail.DimDate d ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
    GROUP BY f.DateKey, pc.ProductCategoryKey, pc.ProductCategoryName, d.IsWorkDay
) t
GROUP BY ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY pct_bigger DESC
